title: nan
authors: Wang F.; Zou Y.; Zhang C.; Buzzatto J.; Liarokapis M.; del Rey Castillo E.; Lim J.B.P.
key_contribution: Presents FMC-SVIL, a fiducial marker-corrected stereo visual-inertial localization method for UAV navigation in large-scale GPS-denied bridge environments, validated with RMSE results under sunny and cloudy conditions.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
